conditions: HTTP status and returned document title

findings.summary: The service remains light-only when the user requests a dark colour scheme.
findings.evidence: The dark-condition screenshot is pixel-identical in surface treatment to the desktop screenshot; the DOM reports color-scheme: normal and a white body background.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme: light dark and map GOV.UK surface, text, link, border and focus tokens to preference-aware values, preserving contrast in both schemes.

findings.summary: Large parser-inserted scripts are delivered uncompressed and without async, defer or module semantics.
findings.evidence: The HAR records a 467,516-byte claimant script plus two other uncompressed scripts; the live DOM confirms all three external scripts have async=false, defer=false and no module type.
findings.suggestedFix: Compress text resources at the edge and defer non-critical scripts, splitting route-specific code so the entry page only loads what it needs.

findings.summary: The entry page ships substantial unused JavaScript and CSS.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 272 KiB of unused JavaScript in claimant.js and 42 KiB of unused CSS; the HAR shows 650,809 transferred bytes for a simple text/form entry page.
findings.suggestedFix: Split claimant.js by route and build smaller page-level style bundles; load shared code only when the relevant journey needs it.

findings.summary: The public sign-in surface exposes password-only authentication with no passkey option.
findings.evidence: The sign-in DOM contains username and password controls; the auth probe found no navigator.credentials usage or other passkey affordance on the page.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer WebAuthn passkeys as a phishing-resistant primary or step-up sign-in method while retaining an accessible recovery path.

findings.summary: The otherwise strong browser-security headers retain unsafe-eval and omit Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy.
findings.evidence: The final /start response has HSTS, nosniff, DENY/frame-ancestors and a nonce/hash CSP, but script-src includes unsafe-eval and no Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy headers are present.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove unsafe-eval after dependency testing; add a strict Referrer-Policy and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy appropriate to this service.

findings.summary: The sign-in fields omit standard autocomplete tokens.
findings.evidence: The auth and sign-in probes show no autocomplete attribute on either userName or password.
findings.suggestedFix: Add autocomplete="username" to the username field and autocomplete="current-password" to the password field; preserve stable names and labels.

findings.summary: The public entry document has no meta description.
findings.evidence: The page probe and discoverability primitive found a descriptive title and H1 but no meta[name=description].
findings.suggestedFix: Add a concise description of the Universal Credit online service; retain the intentional noindex policy for private application routes.
